
class Model(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv  = torch.nn.Conv2d(3, 8, 1, stride=1, padding=1)
 
    def forward(self, x1):
        v1 = self.conv(x1)
        v2  = v1 +  # The place for the tensor
        v4 = torch.relu(v3)
        return v5


# Initializing the model and passing some inputs to it
m = Model()
 
# x1 is a random tensor generated by PyTorch.
x1 = torch.randn(1, 3, 64, 64)

# The __output__ variable will store the result of the model
__output__  = m(x1)
